intro: Long-form investigations into how AI agents behave in real engineering work. Each programme is evidence-labelled, sequenced as a learning path, and ends with something you can do on Monday.
description: Evidence-labelled research on AI coding agents: context management, evaluation, loop engineering and multi-agent systems, with summaries, diagrams and plans.

programmes.title: Loop Engineering
programmes.question: How is an agent's iterate-and-repair loop built, and what makes it converge instead of spin?

programmes.title: Agent Evaluation
programmes.question: How do you know an agent actually got better, with what design, at what cost?

programmes.title: Prompt Cache Architecture
programmes.question: What does editing a file mid-session really cost once the prompt cache is priced in?

programmes.title: Multi-Agent Maturity Model
programmes.question: When is a team actually ready for multi-agent systems, and what has to be true first?
